title: Conjectures: formally verified results on open graph-theory problems
description:
Kernel-checked Lean 4 proofs, graph certificates, independent checkers and papers for results on open problems in graph theory.

Release v1.0.0 contains the paper Small graphs without cycles of length a power of two with its formal development: fδ≥3(4) ≤ 73, fδ≥3(5) ≤ 345 and fcubic(6) ≤ 10,498 (Erdős–Gyárfás conjecture). The proofs use Lean 4.36.0 without Mathlib, without native_decide, and only the standard axioms propext, Classical.choice and Quot.sound.

AI systems (Gemini 4 Neon, Claude Opus 5.5; tools Antigravity and Claude Code) assisted substantially; they are not authors.
keywords: cycles of length a power of two
